sources.title: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the model, MIT release, text/image/audio input and text output, 128K context, nominal 5.6B size, function-calling format, and recommended audio lengths of 40 seconds generally or 30 minutes for summarization.

sources.title: Empowering innovation: The next generation of the Phi family
sources.evidence: February 26, 2025 announcement explicitly says Phi-4-multimodal is now available on Hugging Face and Azure; reports 5.6B and mixture-of-LoRAs.

sources.title: Phi-4-Mini Technical Report: Compact yet Powerful Multimodal Language Models via Mixture-of-LoRAs
sources.evidence: Sections 2.1-2.2 describe the shared dense decoder backbone, vision/audio encoders and projectors, and modality LoRAs. Nominal components are 3.8B backbone, 440M vision encoder/projector, 370M vision LoRA, 460M audio encoder/projector, and 460M audio LoRA. Section 3.1.3 separates experimental reasoning training from the released backbone.

sources.title: Pinned released model configuration
sources.evidence: 32 layers, hidden width 3072, FFN width 8192, 24 query and 8 KV heads, vocabulary 200064, tied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 131072, vision LoRA rank 256 and speech rank 320; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Pinned safetensors shard index
sources.evidence: 2047 tensor entries over three root shards, total_size 11148920768 bytes; already includes both speech and vision LoRA matrices. No separate lm_head tensor is stored.

sources.title: Root shard 1 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only 8-byte length and 237448-byte JSON header using verified HTTP 206 ranges; 1510 BF16 tensors. Header includes the image/audio components and two 80-element audio normalization buffers.

sources.title: Root shard 2 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only 8-byte length and 56128-byte JSON header using verified HTTP 206 ranges; 436 BF16 tensors.

sources.title: Root shard 3 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only 8-byte length and 12840-byte JSON header using verified HTTP 206 ranges; 101 BF16 tensors. Across the three headers, shapes sum to 5574460384 storage elements before excluding 160 buffer elements.

sources.title: Released model implementation and adapter routing
sources.evidence: Defines dense Transformer blocks, tied LM output, learned image separators, and both LoRAs. Forward selects vision LoRA for vision/vision-speech, speech LoRA for speech, and disables LoRAs for language; audio projectors also depend on mode.

sources.title: Released speech encoder implementation
sources.evidence: global_mean and global_invstd are registered buffers, each length 80; exclude them from learned parameters. GLU b1/b2 are nn.Parameter and remain included.

sources.title: Released vision encoder implementation
sources.evidence: The pooling probe and attention projections are learned parameters. Position IDs are a nonpersistent buffer, absent from checkpoint headers; stored learned pooling-head tensors remain part of the complete checkpoint total.

sources.title: Model repository MIT License
sources.evidence: Exact license is MIT, copyright Microsoft Corporation; grants use, modification and redistribution subject to retaining the notice.

sources.title: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B Technical Report, Table 5
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison explicitly includes Phi-4-mm-instruct among non-thinking models. Its thinking-model table and explicit think/nothink control concern the newer reasoning-vision model, not this checkpoint.

sources.title: Released tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: model_max_length is 131072. Chat template explicitly serializes provided tools between tool delimiters and has no separate thinking-mode switch.

sources.title: Hugging Face repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current revision is 93f923e1a7727d1c4f446756212d9d3e8fcc5d81; repository creation is February 24, 2025. Safetensors metadata calls all 5574460384 BF16 storage elements parameters, including the 160 buffers verified separately.

family.note: Microsoft explicitly places this model in the Phi family.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public-availability announcement verified. Repository creation on February 24 does not establish public availability; the later March 3 report date is not the launch date.

open_weights.note: Official checkpoint headers are publicly accessible and licensed for redistribution.

license.note: Exact model repository license, rather than inferred terms from the code library.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique checkpoint count: 5574460384 BF16 elements minus two 80-element nonlearned audio-normalization buffers = 5574460224 parameters. Tied embeddings count once; both LoRAs already occur in root shards. Nominal 5.6B is consistent rounding. Separate exported LoRA files are not added again.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined single active count is disclosed in the examined first-party materials. Encoder/projector and LoRA participation varies by modality and inference phase; total is not a valid per-token active count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer backbone with GQA, vision and conformer audio encoders, projectors, and modality-specific LoRAs. Mixture-of-LoRAs is not sparse FFN expert routing.

context_window.note: Exact configured/tokenizer capacity. Audio recommendations remain task-specific: 40 seconds generally and 30 minutes for summarization; 128K is not evidence of validated hours-long audio performance.

modalities.note: Supported inputs can be combined; output is generated text. Video tasks use image/frame sequences, not an additional native video tensor interface.

reasoning.note: Later Microsoft comparison labels this exact variant non-thinking. Ordinary math/logic capability does not establish a dedicated reasoning mode.

tool_call.note: Native documented function-call prompt format and tools-aware chat template.

description.value: Microsoft's multimodal instruction model for text, image, and audio understanding, with text output and modality-specific LoRA adapters.
description.note: Summarizes documented inputs, output and modality adaptation without performance rankings.

patch.description: Microsoft's multimodal instruction model for text, image, and audio understanding, with text output and modality-specific LoRA adapters.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 5.574460224B learned parameters, nominally 5.6B. Header element total 5.574460384B includes 160 nonlearned audio-normalization buffer elements. Both modality LoRAs are included once; separate adapter exports are not additional parameters. Active parameters vary with input modality and phase and are not separately disclosed. Context is 131072 tokens; recommended audio lengths are 40 seconds generally or 30 minutes for summarization.

summary: Fill total parameters with the complete header/configuration-reconciled 5.574460224B and architecture with dense; clarify the description. Component totals include both modality LoRAs and exclude 160 audio normalization buffer elements. Confirm February 26, 2025 launch, MIT open weights, 131072-token context, native function calling and non-thinking classification. Retain null active parameters because routing depends on modality and phase. Only safetensors headers were read; no complete weights were downloaded or unpickled.
